image_description: A side-profile view of a wombat resting on the ground amidst dry leaves and dirt. The animal has a stocky, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse, brownish-grey fur. Its head is broad with small, rounded ears and a blunt snout. The limbs are short and partially obscured by the body's bulk and the ground angle, but appear robust. The lighting is natural sunlight with some shadows.
